definitions.gloss: central part, middle section, central region
definitions.explanation: The middle portion of something. In Japanese geography, often refers to the Chubu region of central Honshu.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}の{中部|ちゅうぶ}に{位置|いち}する。
examples.english: It is located in central Japan.

examples.japanese: {中部|ちゅうぶ}{地方|ちほう}は{山|やま}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: The Chubu region has many mountains.

examples.japanese: {台風|たいふう}は{今夜|こんや}から{本州|ほんしゅう}{中部|ちゅうぶ}に{接近|せっきん}する{見込|みこ}みだ。
examples.english: The typhoon is expected to approach central Honshu starting tonight.

notes:
GEOGRAPHY:
{中部|ちゅうぶ}{地方|ちほう} (Chubu region) covers nine prefectures in central Honshu, including {愛知|あいち}, {長野|ながの}, {新潟|にいがた}, {石川|いしかわ}, and {静岡|しずおか}. The Japanese Alps run through this region.

WORD FORMATION:
{中|ちゅう} (middle) + {部|ぶ} (part, section)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {中部|ちゅうぶ}{地方|ちほう}: Chubu region
- {中部|ちゅうぶ}{国際空港|こくさいくうこう}: Chubu Centrair International Airport
- {本州|ほんしゅう}{中部|ちゅうぶ}: central Honshu
